title: Explicit Fractalizers: Prime-Order Paley Graphs and other Cayley Graphs
summary: The inducibility problem asks for the maximum number of induced copies of a fixed graph among all graphs with a prescribed number of vertices. Inducibility has been an active area of research in extremal combinatorics, but determining all extremal graphs for explicitly defined patterns remains challenging, particularly when the description is required to hold at every host order.
